annotation_bracket_extraction_method: Chinese Wikisource marks 裴松之注 (Pei Songzhi commentary) inline in HISTORY_BASE using U+3008/U+3009 angle brackets 〈 〉. Content inside a top-level bracket span is classified HISTORY_ANNOTATION; content outside is HISTORY_BASE. This was chosen over a keyword-marker heuristic (e.g. searching for '臣松之') because it also captures pure quoted-source annotation blocks that carry no 'Pei Songzhi' phrase of their own.

known_issues.description: history_base_zh juan 56 has one unmatched opening 〈 bracket (15 open vs 14 close). The pipeline treats any text after the last unmatched open bracket to end-of-paragraph as annotation (fail-open, not silently discarded), but this juan's HISTORY_ANNOTATION/HISTORY_BASE split should be manually spot-checked before R1 relies on it for evidence selection.
